verification.domain_command: uv run --locked python -m pytest -o addopts='' -q --junitxml=.pytest_cache/acknowledgement-domain.xml tests/test_binance_acknowledgements.py tests/test_autonomous.py tests/test_binance_open_intents.py tests/test_binance_close_intents.py tests/test_binance_open_recovery.py tests/test_binance_close_recovery.py tests/test_binance_opening_inventory.py tests/test_execution_lifecycle.py tests/test_positions.py
verification.cli_command: uv run --locked python -m pytest -o addopts='' -q --junitxml=.pytest_cache/acknowledgement-cli.xml tests/test_cli_coverage.py -k 'order_fill or order_executed or spot_roundtrip or command_live'

implemented: One acknowledgement quantity/cash consistency boundary for autonomous and direct CLI response/query projections
Contradictions reject before inventory accounting or adaptive refetch
Original, cumulative and fill-row quantities and cash reconcile when present
Malformed rows, duplicate supplied trade IDs and invalid native fee syntax reject
Product-specific cash units and strict supplied order IDs
Cash/fill execution prices take precedence over convenience averages
Order limit prices and market-price fallbacks cannot establish positive execution
Explicit CLI dry-run simulation behavior is preserved
not_established: Exact native net inventory or native-fee PnL application
Unrounded average division or exact float projections
Complete submitted-order identity and durable-gateway coverage for direct CLI execution
Transactional recovery application, current account qualification or explicit rearm
Independent supervision, comprehensive final review or enterprise readiness
Profitable edge or a performance benchmark
